title: Moya-xiviri lowu nga Endzhaku ka Xifaniso
intro: Endzhutini wa ku rhurha lokukulu eka vulawuri bya tihanyi, xifaniso lexi xa xihundla a xi rindzele emananga. Loko murhangeri wa vanhu lava hlawuriweke a ri karhi a tlhandlukela entshaveni yo kwetsima leswaku a ta va ni xilalelo xa Xikwembu, ndzingo lowukulu wu xike eka lava va saleke. Munhu loyi u teke nkarhi wolowo leswaku a vumba hi vuntshwa ripfumelo ra vaaki hinkwavo. Loko murhangeri a vuya ni ntiyiso, ku lerisiwe nxupulo lowu hlawulekeke ni lowu nga heriki. Xana u nga swi paluxa leswaku moya-xiviri lowu wa njhekanjhekisano ni wa vukanganyisi a wu ri mani?
clues: Ndzi fambe ni vanhu lava ntshunxiweke emavokweni ya mutshikeleri wa matimba hi ku tirhisa swikombiso swa masingita.
Loko murhangeri wa vona a tlhandlukela entshaveni ku ya kuma nkongomiso, ndzi rindze exikarhi ka lava va saleke.
Ndzi hlengelete nsimbi ya risima eka swikhaviso swa vona kutani ndzi yi vumba yi va nchumu lowu humesaka mpfumawulo.
Hi ku tirhisa ntumbuluko lowu, ndzi khorwise xitukulwana hinkwaxo leswaku va kume xikwembu xa vona emananga.
Loko murhangeri a vuya, ndzi hlawuriwile kutani ndzi vutisiwa leswaku i yini lexi ndzi susumeteleke eka vuxisi byo tano.
Nxupulo wa mina emisaveni leyi a ku ri leswaku ku nga vi na munhu loyi a nga ta ndzi khumba kumbe ku tshinela, mfungho wa tingana lowu ndzi wu rhwalelaka hilaha ku nga heriki.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
